original_record.question:
A unit cube is cut twice to form three triangular prisms, two of which are congruent, as shown in Figure 1. The cube is then cut in the same manner along the dashed lines shown in Figure 2. This creates nine pieces. What is the volume of the piece that contains vertex $ W$?

original_record.subject: solid geometry

inventory: Two unit-cube panels Figure1 andFigure2; first pair of V cuts solid in both; perpendicular second V cut traces dashed only inFigure2; W label between panels with two plain leaders pointing to front-top-right vertices.
explicit_conditions: Unit cube; two equal-oriented pairs of cuts into nine pieces, target piece contains W.
layout_choices: Identical projections for both cubes; panel spacing and leader clearance are layout only. Cube back edges absent in source not invented.

answer_check.reasoning: At height z from bottom, W piece has xwidth z/2 and ywidth z/2. Integral0to1 z²/4 dz=1/12, optionA.
